eis_specs.document_title: Fulham Solar Farm And Bess — MP-permit source (v3.31.0 hybrid source-hunt)
eis_specs.connection_augmentation: DC-coupled solar PV + BESS (one of Australia's first at this scale): 105 MWdc / 100.8 MWac solar (80 MWac point of connection) + 64 MWdc / 128 MWh useable BESS on single-axis trackers; EPC and BESS supply contracts executed March 2025; VRET-2 offtake
eis_specs.notes: Solar 80 MWac. BESS 64 MW / 128 MWh (2.0h duration). Regime: MP-permit. Ministerial planning permit PA2101365-4 (updated 4 Dec 2024). 80 MW solar + 128 MWh BESS on the Hopkins Rd / McLarens Rd site near Fulham, VIC (~200 km east of Melbourne). Backed by VRET-2 offtake; construction started April 2025, operational 2027. Octopus Investments-owned via Gippsland New Energy.
